server.title: Multifunctional Server
server.description: Self-hosted Ubuntu server running containerized services, with hardened security, VPN remote access and fully automated maintenance.

highlights.title: Containerization
highlights.desc: Media streaming, content automation and password management in Docker containers managed with Portainer.

highlights.title: Security
highlights.desc: Traefik reverse-proxy over HTTPS, Crowdsec intrusion detection, IP masked by Cloudflare and WireGuard remote access.

highlights.title: Automation
highlights.desc: Containers and Ubuntu packages (unattended upgrades) update themselves without manual intervention.

website.title: Portfolio
website.description: Bilingual portfolio built with Next.js and TypeScript, with dark and light modes, deployed via Docker with a GitLab CI/CD pipeline.

highlights.title: Animations & interactions
highlights.desc: Smooth scrolling (Lenis), GSAP text effects, an animated project grid and a circular theme transition.

highlights.title: Performance & SEO
highlights.desc: Server-side rendering, IndexNow indexing and a contact form validated on the server.

highlights.title: Bilingual
highlights.desc: French and English via next-intl, with per-locale routing.

gaming.title: Video Game
gaming.description: Team project built with Unity and C#. Players design their own 3D city and explore it in first-person, with Spider-Man-inspired movement mechanics.

highlights.title: City builder
highlights.desc: 3D object placement and a Unity UI build menu to create your own city.

highlights.title: Camera systems
highlights.desc: Orthogonal, free and FPS cameras for a smooth switch between building and exploring.

highlights.title: Movement mechanics
highlights.desc: Sprint, jump, wallrun and web-swinging powered by Unity Physics.

ai.title: Giant Tic-Tac-Toe AI
ai.description: University project: an AI agent playing Giant Tic-Tac-Toe — a nested 3×3 board where each move constrains the opponent's next play zone.

highlights.title: Minimax & Alpha-Beta pruning
highlights.desc: Searches a very large state space to choose the best move.

highlights.title: Heuristics & move generation
highlights.desc: Custom evaluation that prioritizes winning moves while respecting the board's nested constraints.

highlights.title: Network play
highlights.desc: Competes against other agents on a game server.

earth.title: Earth Globe
earth.description: Interactive 3D globe built with Next.js and CesiumJS, with city search and self-hosted map tiles.

highlights.title: 3D Globe
highlights.desc: Real-time interactive Earth with satellite imagery, 3D terrain and a realistic atmosphere.

highlights.title: Self-hosted services
highlights.desc: Nominatim geocoder to fly to any city, and TileServer-GL for switchable map styles.

highlights.title: Skybox & atmosphere
highlights.desc: 6-face space skybox with tunable atmospheric parameters.
